REVEREND EARL
SHERMAN PIERCE
The Reverend Earl Sherman
Pierce-60 died September 24 at
home in Petersburg,N.J
Father Pierce was the retired
Rector of St.AugustineEpisco-
pal Church where he served for
23 years.He received his Mas-
ter of Divinity M.Div) degree
from the Philadelphia School of
ProtestantEpiscopa.
Church.He was also an alumni
ofGlassboro State College
(Rowan University), where he
received his Bachelor of Arts
degree, and was a graduate of
BridgetonRegionalHigh
School. Father Pierce worked
as the Affirmative Action Offi
cer for the South Jersey Trans-
portation Authority for more
than 10 years.At his death,he
held the position as Manager
Political Liaison.
Father Earl Pierce was a
strong advocate of Civil Rights
and social change in the
African-American community
